text.tspan: K40 CO₂ laser · Type 2 / Mini Gerbil 2 reference
MAIN WIRING · one controller at the centre · one conductor per route
Selected controller build: follow each named terminal and match every route ID to the evidence list below.
DOTTED = GUESS / proposed wire; verify before connecting
OPEN = no connection until the missing evidence is obtained
Crossing lines are not junctions. Only named terminal circles are connection points. Repeated controller labels are contact references, not extra physical pins.
Selected machine retrofit · individual contact references

g.title: C01-001 · X min endstop signal · Trace cable with power isolated; confirm dry contact and NO/NC state. Leave selector pin 1 unused for passive switches; powered sensors require a matched interface.
C01-002 · X min endstop GND · Trace cable with power isolated; confirm dry contact and NO/NC state. Leave selector pin 1 unused for passive switches; powered sensors require a matched interface.
C02-001 · Y min endstop signal · Trace cable with power isolated; confirm dry contact and NO/NC state. Leave selector pin 1 unused for passive switches; powered sensors require a matched interface.
C02-002 · Y min endstop GND · Trace cable with power isolated; confirm dry contact and NO/NC state. Leave selector pin 1 unused for passive switches; powered sensors require a matched interface.

C03-001 · J35.6 · PWM candidate · G/IN/5V are source labels. Confirm the fitted PSU model, input threshold and compatible level interface; the Mini Gerbil installation is not evidence of direct Core 3.3 V compatibility. Laser firing enable is a separate circuit, not supplied by intensity PWM.

C03-001 · J35.6 · PWM candidate · G/IN/5V are source labels. Confirm the fitted PSU model, input threshold and compatible level interface; the Mini Gerbil installation is not evidence of direct Core 3.3 V compatibility. Laser firing enable is a separate circuit, not supplied by intensity PWM.

C03-002 · J35.10 · GND · G/IN/5V are source labels. Confirm the fitted PSU model, input threshold and compatible level interface; the Mini Gerbil installation is not evidence of direct Core 3.3 V compatibility. Laser firing enable is a separate circuit, not supplied by intensity PWM.

C03-002 · J35.10 · GND · G/IN/5V are source labels. Confirm the fitted PSU model, input threshold and compatible level interface; the Mini Gerbil installation is not evidence of direct Core 3.3 V compatibility. Laser firing enable is a separate circuit, not supplied by intensity PWM.

C04-001 · J35.7 · run request candidate · Identify active level, firing terminal and water/door/key/E-stop contacts from the fitted PSU manual. Retain the independent hardware inhibition chain; do not bridge an interlock. PSU 5V is an output/reference, not a Core PWM pin.

C04-001 · J35.7 · run request candidate · Identify active level, firing terminal and water/door/key/E-stop contacts from the fitted PSU manual. Retain the independent hardware inhibition chain; do not bridge an interlock. PSU 5V is an output/reference, not a Core PWM pin.
C05-001 · X motor phase B2 · Alternative to the external-driver circuit, never simultaneously connected. Verify selected Prime revision, current settings, supply rating and winding pairs.
C05-002 · X motor phase B1 · Alternative to the external-driver circuit, never simultaneously connected. Verify selected Prime revision, current settings, supply rating and winding pairs.
C05-003 · X motor phase A2 · Alternative to the external-driver circuit, never simultaneously connected. Verify selected Prime revision, current settings, supply rating and winding pairs.
C05-004 · X motor phase A1 · Alternative to the external-driver circuit, never simultaneously connected. Verify selected Prime revision, current settings, supply rating and winding pairs.
C06-001 · Y motor phase B2 · Alternative to the external-driver circuit, never simultaneously connected. Verify selected Prime revision, current settings, supply rating and winding pairs.
C06-002 · Y motor phase B1 · Alternative to the external-driver circuit, never simultaneously connected. Verify selected Prime revision, current settings, supply rating and winding pairs.
C06-003 · Y motor phase A2 · Alternative to the external-driver circuit, never simultaneously connected. Verify selected Prime revision, current settings, supply rating and winding pairs.
C06-004 · Y motor phase A1 · Alternative to the external-driver circuit, never simultaneously connected. Verify selected Prime revision, current settings, supply rating and winding pairs.

C07-001 · Prime regulated logic supply · Prime alternative only. Confirm fitted P11/P12 revision, input-voltage/current limits, supply sequencing and fuse/conductor ratings. Never connect both Core external drivers and Prime winding outputs to the same motor.

C08-001 · Independent water/door protection input · Cloudray MYJG-40 NW is a reference variant only, not proof of installed PSU. Follow matching manufacturer isolation and active-level requirements; do not bridge WP or remove water/door/E-stop checks. Existing L/LO labels elsewhere describe other possible PSU variants.
